subject: Interleaved driver rotation in East US 3 — planned windows & mitigation
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: ops@acme-customer.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:00:00 +0000
Subject: Interleaved driver rotation in East US 3 — planned windows & mitigation

Hi team,

We have a planned, low-impact maintenance operation for the East US 3 runtime fleet that will run as an interleaved driver/kernel rotation. This is a rolling, host-by-host process designed to avoid simultaneous restarts in any single tenant pool.

Summary:
- What: driver + kernel microversion rotation to enable improved NIC stability and new telemetry hooks.
- When: June 24–25, 2026, 02:00–10:00 UTC each day (work will be staged across AZs).
- Regions affected: East US 3 (targeted host pool only).
- Expected impact: transient connection resets for in-flight sessions on specific hosts; typical reconnection within 10–60s. No full region outage expected.

Key mitigations we apply:
- Interleaved choreography to keep warm KV caches and avoid mass eviction.
- Progressive canary on 5% of capacity, then ramp with automated rollback if error rates exceed thresholds.
- Explicit health-check gating and prioritized fallback to secondary replicas where appropriate.

Action items for Acme:
1) Please confirm whether you have any blackout windows during the proposed times.
2) Identify any long-running jobs (>=10 minutes) that we should coordinate to avoid restarts mid-run.
3) Provide preferred escalation contact for the maintenance window.

Attachments: eastus3_driver_rotation_plan.csv (schedule by host), rollback_playbook.pdf (runbook), maintenance_graphs.png (expected telemetry).

We will post live updates to the HubSpot record and Jira INF-4521, and will keep a dedicated Slack channel open for the window.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Program Manager, Infrastructure Reliability
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 12:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Interleaved driver rotation in East US 3 — planned windows & mitigation

Olga — quick internal note before we send to the broader customer list.

- Make sure the CSV includes per-AZ start times; Acme runs long batch jobs in az-2.
- Add the pre-check: confirm backups of KV caches and ensure pre-warm threshold is met before host drains.
- I'll own the on-call rotation for June 24 (02:00–06:00 UTC) and Karthik will take 06:00–10:00 UTC.

Also suggest we offer Acme a single hour of priority assistance (free) for any reconnection tuning post-maintenance — helps with goodwill and keeps support noise down.

Marissa
Director, Customer Reliability
marissa_cole@redwood.com

- Long-running jobs: confirmed — two pipelines (etl-acme-1 and etl-acme-2) that commonly run ~20m. We will pin those away from the scheduled hosts during the maintenance.
- Escalation contact: Our SRE lead is Priya N. (pri.sre@acme-customer.com) and our Pager is +1-555-210-0099.
